title: Claude Code's /rewind Reported Success and Restored Nothing
caption:
I hit /rewind, saw it say done, and kept building on a rollback that never happened.

Claude Code 2.1.260 fixed /rewind and --rewind-files reporting success when the checkpoint backup files were missing — nothing was actually restored. Shipped Sept 3.

Honest admission: I trusted the confirmation line instead of checking the diff. Not doing that again.

Do you check diffs?

slides.headline:
Rewind Said Done.
Nothing Restored.
slides.sub: Claude Code's /rewind reported success when its checkpoint backup files were missing. Nothing was actually restored. Fixed Sept 3 in 2.1.260.
